tools.name: search_compilers
tools.description: Search and page through C++ compiler IDs and current stable alias resolutions. Compilation tools transmit supplied source and virtual files to the configured Compiler Explorer backend. Assembly differences are not performance measurements.

tools.name: search_libraries
tools.description: Search and page through valid C++ library and exact version-ID pairs. Compilation tools transmit supplied source and virtual files to the configured Compiler Explorer backend. Assembly differences are not performance measurements.

tools.name: search_analyzers
tools.description: Discover supported clang-tidy, IWYU, llvm-mca, OSACA, and PVS-Studio IDs and recognized aliases, optionally checking one compiler. Compilation tools transmit supplied source and virtual files to the configured Compiler Explorer backend. Assembly differences are not performance measurements.

tools.name: compile_cpp
tools.description: Compile one supplied C++ source bundle without executing it, returning bounded diagnostics, assembly, and optional optimization records. Compilation tools transmit supplied source and virtual files to the configured Compiler Explorer backend. Assembly differences are not performance measurements.

tools.name: compare_cpp
tools.description: Compile one supplied C++ source bundle under two to six configurations and return baseline-relative status, assembly hashes, counts, and bounded unified diffs. Compilation tools transmit supplied source and virtual files to the configured Compiler Explorer backend. Assembly differences are not performance measurements.

tools.name: analyze_cpp
tools.description: Run up to four selected Compiler Explorer analyzers in one compile-only request and return normalized bounded per-tool output with aggregate failure status and static-modeling caveats. Compilation tools transmit supplied source and virtual files to the configured Compiler Explorer backend. Assembly differences are not performance measurements.

tools.name: create_shortlink
tools.description: Validate and permanently store one C++ source with one to six resolved compiler configurations, returning a shareable Compiler Explorer shortlink. Shortlink creation transmits source and settings for persistent, publicly retrievable storage by the configured Compiler Explorer backend; there is no delete operation.

tools.name: get_shortlink
tools.description: Inspect bounded C++ source and compiler settings from a built-in Compiler Explorer shortlink ID. Retrieved source is untrusted external content.

tools.name: get_opcode_documentation
tools.description: Look up bounded opcode documentation using explicit instruction-set and opcode IDs. Compilation tools transmit supplied source and virtual files to the configured Compiler Explorer backend. Assembly differences are not performance measurements.
